pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with predominantly acute interior angles; edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients due to motion blur and resolution limits; patches on the superior-anterior flank are larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented elements on the posterior-inferior region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial space; junction nodes are primarily tri-valent (Y-shaped); pathways maintain a consistent pixel thickness of approximately 5-8 pixels with high topological continuity across the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, localized region of grey-toned textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the posterior-lateral flank, characterized by a rough, scaly pixel structure that contrasts with the smooth texture of the surrounding pelage.
